entries.topic: Documentary admissions: scope, identity and audit trail
entries.title: Signed approval requires scope and qualification
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: A source reviewer can attest to observed page, not legal chess engine or commercial rights.
entries.required_future_evidence: Separate assessor competencies and signoffs by claim and asset.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject global APPROVED from an unrelated PR review.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: Qd8 factuality gets an outcome separate from move recall
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Knowing d8 appears does not mean the viewer knows it was never played.
entries.required_future_evidence: Neutral recall asks whether it was played and confidence in answer.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject 'recognized Qd8' as equivalent to recognizing UNPLAYED.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: Recall of Bxb6 need not imply comprehension of sacrifice
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Viewers may notice queen captured but not understand Be6 threatened c4.
entries.required_future_evidence: Use separate factual and tactical-understanding items.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Do not summarize all tactics with one multiple-choice question.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: Movement between 45s and 60s arms changes exposure order
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Repeating the same game can improve second viewing without any edit improvement.
entries.required_future_evidence: Protocol controls counterbalancing or between-subject allocation.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No causal claim for edit superiority under single fixed order.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: A cut that is semantically faithful may still confuse the viewer
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: ALT-A holds V-REAL then cuts to V-EV2 under elision; viewers may infer direct capture.
entries.required_future_evidence: Question asks whether missing moves occurred between displayed boards.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No media IVV PASS from JSON invariants alone.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: Questions about unseen internal c3 cannot be scored as failure
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: T11 source is TECHNICAL_ONLY and ALT-A does not animate from c3.
entries.required_future_evidence: Evaluate captured piece and result if origin never shown.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject rubric requiring hidden technical movement recognition.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: Observation with subtitles and muted audio are not equivalent
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Captions may be disabled and on-platform UI moves them.
entries.required_future_evidence: Protocol defines playback mode and presentation explicitly.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No transfer of captions-on PASS to silent captions-off users.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: A visual safety gate precedes participants
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Strobing or unsafe effects are not validated by comprehension questionnaires.
entries.required_future_evidence: Technical safety QC on actual media before any participant exposure.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject recruitment into uninspected flash-heavy prototype.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: Nonresponse is different from incorrect answer
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: A viewer who skipped early cannot answer about end label reliably.
entries.required_future_evidence: Define exposure sufficiency and missing-data handling before collecting.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No post hoc removal of low-comprehension viewers to inflate PASS.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: A confidence rating is not evidence of historical truth
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Participants can confidently repeat an editorial error if a cue is wrong.
entries.required_future_evidence: Grade against independently verified source and event contract.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Do not accept confident consensus as chess or history oracle.

entries.topic: Study quality: credible perception of the real-versus-unplayed line
entries.title: Global IVV requires more than one favorable question
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Four accurate answers on queen capture do not cover T07 return, T10 gap or T12 close.
entries.required_future_evidence: Criterion maps coverage to all protected failure modes.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No IVV_GLOBAL PASS via narrow subset of questionnaire.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: The strict inequality cannot be changed by rounding
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Policy B requires termination and confirmation before 120 s, not at 120s.
entries.required_future_evidence: Proof includes clock semantics and satisfies strictly t<120 for all relevant processes.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject any claim that 120.000s is an allowed edge case.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: A wrapper is not the whole process family
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: An orchestrator might finish while its children survive under failure model M.
entries.required_future_evidence: Qualified process inventory includes descendants and independently confirms each termination.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No PASS from wrapper exit without descendant closure.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: Captured stdout is not all emitted stdout
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: The collector can truncate bytes without preventing program from emitting more.
entries.required_future_evidence: Separate counts of emitted and accepted stdout across lifetime.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Do not measure only returned response body as emitted total.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: stderr bound does not share stdout spare budget
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Separate 1,048,576-byte caps are required for each output channel.
entries.required_future_evidence: Show individual lifetime emitted/accepted tallies for both streams.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject combined-cap arithmetic or overflow offset.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: A successful nominal run does not refute NO-GO under M
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: E5B4D formal conclusion concerns strict guarantees under a stated failure model, not an average runtime.
entries.required_future_evidence: A proposed revision has formal proof compatible with unchanged model and all invariants.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No execution permission from fast nominal benchmark.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: Static source check is evidence of text only
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Git readback can establish file identity and consistency; it cannot measure processes or frame truth.
entries.required_future_evidence: Keep SOURCE_VALIDATED separate from RUNTIME_QUALIFIED.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject any inference that repository reads satisfy Policy B.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: Negative specification count is not passed test count
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: 77 router cases and 66 semantic cases are written, not executed.
entries.required_future_evidence: Dashboard maintains separate specified_count and executed_count.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No metric '143 tests passed' without actual run reports.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: No unapproved Actions via harmless looking commit
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: A repository source edit may trigger workflows under some configurations; no project Actions are authorized.
entries.required_future_evidence: Perform only permitted source-only GitHub actions, avoid triggering execution paths.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Do not enact workflow_dispatch or merge under NO-GO.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: Fail-closed release flags remain unaltered
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: PR #11 release permit false and PR #1 frozen gates remain controlling.
entries.required_future_evidence: Inspect exact flags before any contemplated media publication.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject a source-only document that claims it overrode release=false.

entries.topic: The model M impossibility frontier and frozen semantics
entries.title: Human autonomy does not solve physics of monitoring
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Delegated chess decisions permit research, not false process guarantees or forged rights.
entries.required_future_evidence: Maintain M incompatibility until explicit formally adequate mechanism exists.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No proxy decision claiming user delegation equals technical PASS.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: Historical result UNKNOWN is a visible release risk
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Case `historical_end.result` is UNKNOWN while secondary score ending is Rc2#.
entries.required_future_evidence: Future editorial dossier either qualifies ending truth with direct sources or omits it.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No confident original terminal-mechanism headline on current record.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: The absent complete source PGN blocks independent audit
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Case hashes for PGN and R2 artifact are declared-not-checked; originals missing.
entries.required_future_evidence: Obtain legally available exact bytes and record hash verification before claiming audited 82 moves.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Do not derive FULL_PGN_VERIFIED from checkpoint excerpts.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: Unplayed Qd8 must remain explicit in any marketing asset
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: A faithful master can still spawn a misleading thumbnail or subject line.
entries.required_future_evidence: A claim-to-asset review treats every derivative as separate output.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Reject promotional piece implying Qd8 happened.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: ALT-A preserves technical-state invisibility by design
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: V-PRE-EV2 is technical only; hard cut moves to V-EV2 after 14-ply omission.
entries.required_future_evidence: Qualified media QA shows no source board or false Nxd1 tween.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Do not approve from static JSON alone.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: R6 must be checked for the actual asset binaries
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: A prototype piece glyph or font name is not legal clearance of final distributed file.
entries.required_future_evidence: Ledger records binary, author, terms, usage, territory and approval.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No inherited rights PASS from source declaration.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: C2PA does not certify game truth
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: A signed media manifest can show provenance but cannot itself judge factual accuracy.
entries.required_future_evidence: Keep provenance and historical claim review nontransitive.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No history PASS just because C2PA is valid.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: Distribution rights and platform eligibility differ
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Licensed chess content might still violate YouTube repetitive or reused content rules at channel level.
entries.required_future_evidence: Originality review tests episode-specific analysis and broader catalogue.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No YPP approval predicted from license status.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: Human IVV cannot be simulated with model answers
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: A model that built the truth questionnaire knows its answers and is not a blind participant.
entries.required_future_evidence: Only real, qualified participants with defined stimuli count toward IVV.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No virtual panel of agents presented as human empirical evidence.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: Main and publication each need an independently authorized action
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: Draft PR #12 holds research and no part of current context authorizes merging or publishing.
entries.required_future_evidence: Formal release file contains competent gate approvals and explicit publish permission.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: Do not merge or upload because B1370 has been reached.

entries.topic: Episode release dossier, gaps and marginal research priority
entries.title: Next investigation should purchase decision information, not count
entries.observation_or_bounded_inference: After B1370 the missing classes are external witness access, original bytes, formal M solution, rights and human media QC.
entries.required_future_evidence: Rank future action by probability of eliminating uncertainty and actual admissibility, not title novelty.
entries.reject_or_inconclusive_if: No '1370 verified checks' framing for research entries.
